headline: Changes to City Council rules, orders, and standing committees to better align council procedures with council duties.
summary: Possible changes to the council's rules and orders will be discussed. Possible changes to the council's standing committees will also be discussed.
items: Discuss amendments, additions, or removals to the Rules and Orders of the City Council to better align council procedures with council duties.
Discuss the City Council Standing Committees and possible changes to better align council procedures with council duties.
location: City Council Chambers, 93 Washington St., Salem, MA, 2nd Floor
plain_text:
City of Salem, Massachusetts 
Office of the City Clerk 
 
 Maureen Elizabeth Fisher 
City Clerk 
 
 
 
 
 
October 27, 2026 
 
 
 
 
MEETING NOTICE AND AGENDA 
 
The Salem City Council Committee of the Whole will meet in person on Monday 
November 9, 2026, at 6:00 PM for the purpose of discussing Rules and Orders of the City 
Council in order to identify amendments, additions, or removals, to better align official 
and unofficial council procedures with the responsibilities of the Council and  
meet to discuss the City Council Standing Committees in order to evaluate changes to 
better align official and unofficial council procedures with the responsibilities of the 
Council. This meeting will be held in the City Council Chambers. 93 Washington St., 
Salem, MA, 2nd Floor.
